## BNDES disburses R$2.7 billion in working capital financing for LATAM Airlines Brazil


11/26/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/986550758/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/26/BNDES-NOV-2026-ENG.pdf)


**November 26, 2026** – LATAM Airlines Brazil received on this date R$2.664 billion from the Brazilian Development Bank (BNDES) under a long-term loan agreement funded with resources from the National Civil Aviation Fund (FNAC).


The transaction is part of a working capital financing facility for airlines operating domestic flights in Brazil. It aims to support liquidity and working capital across the sector amid pressure on operating costs, particularly those related to jet fuel.


With a final maturity in July 2031, monthly amortization and an annual cost of 5.6%, the financing enhances LATAM Airlines Brazil’s financial flexibility and mitigates part of the effects of the increase in jet fuel prices recorded in 2026.


The loan agreement contributes to the economic sustainability of the aviation sector, which is strategic for passenger and cargo transportation, Brazil’s connectivity, the development of tourism and business, the transport of goods, and the growth of the Brazilian economy.
